title: Also BPA Free..Chipped in 2 weeks!
text:
Also BPA Free..Chipped in 2 weeks!. Back again with another update: 7-23-13

I returned the second set to Amazon because of the chipping & scratches near the handle in the larger pan.
That said, I still love these pans..
They do have to be seasoned before using them.
I use organic coconut oil. Just wipe it around with a paper towel.
Do Not use any type of cooking spray oils on any fry pans. The pan becomes sticky, and unusable .

Pans heat quick, and there is even cooking with these pans.

If there are no more chipping on these pans, this would be 5 stars..
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
6-30-13
I'm up dating from my first review below.
As I mentioned the first set , the larger pan came in scratches. Got a new set of the same pans, and love them, but only for two weeks,
As then the larger pan again, started to have the Ceramic come off, and bumps under the ceramic that caused the Ceramic to chips!
What a shame, as I really liked these pans..
That said, it has only happened to the larger pan!..I used both pans to mainly make eggs in, and one time salmon in the larger pan.

These pans had so much going for them, but chip in two weeks!. Not acceptable.

There needs to be more quality control.!!
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

This is my first review:
I have so much Calphalon commercial cookware, which is getting heavy for me, and most is that awful Non-stick etc.
I thought I would give these a try..Love them. such a nice surprise.

I called the company, and was told the cookware is made in China.
These did not say if there BPA free..The company said Yes
these are BPA Free...

They cook just as even as my Calphalon cookware, and clean up is very easy with a little soap and water.
These heat up fast, because of the Aluminum core, and pans are not real thick, These pans are not heavy, which I like.,
but have some weight to them.
The handle has a good grip. Easy to use.
I cook on a gas range.

It says you can put them in the dishwasher, although I do not put my pans in the dishwasher. So I have no idea how they come out!
Since there so easy to clean, why fill up the dishwasher with these pans.
You can use medal utensils , although I have not.

I do love these pans..
Some one else mentioned the package said to heat to 350 degrees..Although Amazon says 700 degrees, which is not true.

The only Con I have is Amazon, as the price keeps changing. Sometimes by the hour!!..
I paid over $33.00,now there $29.00 something.
The set was $80.00 then went up to $118.00...Now there down to $100.00 !!

The company also told me this cookware sells at, Walmart, Sears, and K-mart..
How long there going to hold up for, Who knows!!
When I got these, the larger pan had scratches in it. Amazon had them picked up the next day, and about 3 days later I received the new set..Perfect.

I Would buy these again.
